name: GhostTextarea
description: Headless native multiline text control. useGhostTextarea owns v-model, disabled/readonly/invalid/required, and SSR-safe auto-resize; GhostTextarea is the thin unstyled textarea. Themed styles live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grow the field with its content after mount. Off by default so native resize and a fixed rows height remain the ordinary path.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value. Later changes are ignored.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled semantics: not focusable, not editable, omitted from form submit.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Sets aria-invalid=true. Error copy belongs to Field or the surrounding form.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Auto-resize ceiling in rows. Ignored unless autoResize is true. When set below rows, rows wins as both min and max.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled value. Omit for uncontrolled mode; an empty string is a defined empty value.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Native readonly semantics: focusable and submitted, but the user agent rejects edits.

props.name: required
props.description: Native required constraint. Validation messaging stays with the form.

props.name: rows
props.description: Native rows. Matches the HTML default. Auto-resize uses this as the minimum height.

models.description: v-model binding for the textarea string.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native textarea when it is mounted. No-op before mount.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native textarea after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native textarea when it is mounted and enabled. No-op before mount.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable field. Wins data-state when overlapping readonly or invalid. Prefer the native disabled attribute.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Focusable but not editable. Wins data-state over invalid. Native readonly remains the semantic source of truth.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Consumer-owned invalid. Used when the field is neither disabled nor readonly. Themed CSS also keys off aria-invalid.

keyboard.Enter: Insert a newline. Does not submit the form.
keyboard.Tab: Leave the field. Native tab order.
